Familiarity or experience with Databricks and Snowflake is a plus.  What do we have to offer you?  Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage; Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model; Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers; Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness; Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time; Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community; We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education; Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages; Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.  What makes us different?  Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy; We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift; We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude; We promote closeness and an informal environment; Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.  Your next adventure starts here!  If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV! The future is waiting for you — and so are we! For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . Será considerando um diferencial:  Certificações AWS, como: AWS Solutions Architect AWS DevOps Engineer AWS Security Specialist Conhecimento em FinOps e otimização de custos cloud; Experiência com arquitetura orientada a microsserviços; Vivência com metodologias ágeis; Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta criticidade. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses. Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.  O que oferecemos?  SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional. Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho. SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social. E muito mais!  + Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração  Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência. Faça parte da nossa equipe!  #VempraSONDA

title: Operations Manager (Product)
description:
Empresa está contratando Operations Manager (Product) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About Revolut  People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role  At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth. We’re looking for a Product Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers. Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch. What you’ll be doing  Developing a point of view on specific fintech verticals and defining a cohesive long-term strategy for the company and product departments Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, feeding information from the market back into company strategy and department roadmaps Tracking and analysing competitive position and product performance globally Helping scope and launch new verticals for the company Defining initial product proposition and go-to-market strategies for new expansion markets  What you'll need  At least a 2:1 degree from a top university A STEM or other highly quantitative degree from a top-tier university A track record of outstanding achievement in different areas 3+ years of experience in a strategy consulting, investment banking/PE/VC, or fast-growing technology company in a product or strategy role Great problem-solving skills A focus on customer-centric designs and solutions  Nice to have  A track record of building successful products (ideally financial) using data, customer feedback, common sense, and/or machine learning  Compensation range  Krakow: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly* Poland: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly* Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process  *Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels.  We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive.  Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.  If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. title: Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer  Job Purpose  As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem. AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb. The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms. This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function. Role Responsibilities  Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation. Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services. Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA. Author and maintain PowerShell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate. Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service. Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning. Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards. Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards. Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.  Essential Skills & Experience  Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary) 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above. Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery. Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering. IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning. DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience. Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity. Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments. Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.  Identity & Authentication Hybrid identity: AD on-prem ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS. SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting. Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.  AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence) Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch. AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store. AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.  Note:  Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow. Service Operations & Remote Working Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management. Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA. Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken. Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup. Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.  Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement  This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer: Working hours:  You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office. Home office:  Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role. Engagement model:  PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage. Equipment & expenses:  Discussed at offer stage. On-call:  Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

Repository & Documentation Management : Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.  Quality & Content Oversight  Quality Oversight:  Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles; consistent visual style; complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX); and no unintended logos or asset errors. English–Portuguese Alignment:  Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content. Content Integrity Assurance:  Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.  Operations & Issue Resolution  Technical Issue Resolution:  Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.  Daily Operational Troubleshooting:  Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.  Reporting, Assets & Documentation  Reporting & Performance Tracking:  Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.  Asset & Process Management:  Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.  Repository & Documentation Management:  Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.  Operations & Issue Resolution  Technical Issue Resolution:  Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges. Daily Operational Troubleshooting:  Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards. Risk Prevention & Escalation:  Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output.  Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field. Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography. Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role. Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere); familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus. Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency. Demonstrated leadership and team management experience. Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills. Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability. Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation. Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.g., US and India teams) and local production teams. Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction. Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets. High level of ownership and accountability over end-to-end production outcomes. Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

title: Arquiteto de Software
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Arquiteto de Software em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix  é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo  Arquiteto de Software  é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix . Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais:  Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma  Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos.  Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL  Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho.  Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código  Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos.  Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria  Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa.  Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA  Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem.  Requisitos Técnicos:  Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown.  Requisitos Desejáveis:  Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação.  Processo de Candidatura:  Candidatura:  Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico:  Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão:  Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.  Por que trabalhar na VMetrix  Na VMetrix , não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix  é o lugar.

description:

About us Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near. We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy. We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it. The role We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets. You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short. You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high. What we’re looking for We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet. You should have: 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow  Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC. What we offer Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that. You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously. This is a fully remote position. One thing worth knowing There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

About Andela  At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America. As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster. Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI. Join us and change the world. Role Overview  We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / AI)  to help build and scale the next generation of applications for one of our growing enterprise clients. This is a senior-level engineering role with a strong backend focus, combining modern full-stack development with AI-powered application development. You will be responsible for architecting and building scalable systems, establishing development standards, integrating Generative AI solutions into production environments, and driving technical decisions across multiple initiatives. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building systems from scratch, and can operate as a highly autonomous technical leader while collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders. Exceptional Leadership  As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you. Low ego, low drama, servant leader:  You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea. One team mentality:  You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone. Great listener, hungry for feedback:  You’re always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter:  You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Player-coach:  You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging. Business problem solver:  You’re not just a functional expert; you approach your work through the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities  Backend Architecture & Development  Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using .NET and C#. Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures. Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Full-Stack Development  Collaborate with frontend teams working in React to deliver end-to-end application functionality. Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus. Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services. Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. AI & Generative AI Integration  Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications. Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features. Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value. Technical Leadership & Solution Design  Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects. Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure. Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation. Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Collaboration & Delivery  Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Partner with leadership to align technical strategy with business goals. Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities. Ensure solutions are delivered with high quality and maintainability. Qualifications & Competencies  Experience  8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development. Extensive hands-on experience with .NET and C#. Strong full-stack development experience with modern web application architectures. Experience building and deploying production-grade applications. Experience working in startup, scale-up, or high-growth environments. AI & Modern Engineering  Proven experience integrating Generative AI solutions into production applications. Hands-on experience working with LLMs, AI-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems. Understanding of AI orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, or AI application architecture. Experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI technologies. Technical Expertise  Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems. Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend services. Deep understanding of modern development practices, testing strategies, and deployment workflows. Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities. Leadership & Communication  Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact technical decisions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. Strong ownership mentality and accountability for outcomes. Nice to Have  Experience with Claude and AI orchestration frameworks. Experience with AI agents, RAG architectures, or advanced LLM implementation patterns. Experience building products or platforms from scratch. Experience leading technical teams or serving as a technical lead. Experience working in highly autonomous engineering environments.  What We’re Looking For  We're looking for someone who is more than a software developer. The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who can own technical outcomes, architect scalable solutions, integrate AI into real-world products, and operate with minimal oversight. You should be comfortable making architectural decisions, solving complex backend challenges, collaborating across functions, and leveraging AI technologies to create business impact. This role is best suited for someone who is highly autonomous, technically strong, product-minded, and excited about building the future of AI-enabled software systems. Role Details  Location : Remote (LATAM / Americas) Time Zone : Must maintain a minimum of 6 hours overlap with US working hours Contract Type : Contracting Duration : 12 Months Expected Start Date : 22 June 2026 Assessment Path : .NET Required Technologies : .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, Generative AI Apply Now  Apply now to join Andela's global talent network and support the development of next-generation AI-powered applications for a fast-growing technology-driven organization. This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys modern architecture, AI-powered development, technical leadership, and building scalable systems from the ground up.

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro de dados S em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Quem Somos  A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Sobre a posição  Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização. A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor. Principais Responsabilidades  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud. • Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake. • Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes. • Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento. • Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure. • Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados. • Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas. • Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias. Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções. • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis. • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados. • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua. DevOps e Qualidade • Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização. • Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps. • Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas. • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe. Requisitos Obrigatórios  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos). • Experiência prática com Snowflake. • Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures. • Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud. • Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps. • Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados. • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub. • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban). • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global. Diferenciais • Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click. • Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics. • Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas. • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial. • Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and leadership teams, including in distributed team environments.  Other Abilities: Strong curiosity and passion for AI innovation. Ability to work effectively in fast-paced and evolving technical environments. Self-driven problem solver capable of working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements. Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:

Company Description:  MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview:  As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness. Offer Details:   Duration of Contract : 12 months Pay:  $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work:  Fully Remote Number of Positions:  20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)   Key Qualifications:  Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)  with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese  is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Description:  In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.  Education & Experience:  BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.  Additional Details:  Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: CloudSEK’s Product Suite:  CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones:  2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.  Job Description:  As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients. Key Responsibilities:  Account Management:  Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.  Cybersecurity Expertise:  Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.  Customer Engagement:  Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.  Revenue Generation and Retention:  Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.  Product Usage and Feedback:  Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.  Operational Excellence:  Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.  Ideal candidate:   4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.  Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.  Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.  Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts  simultaneously.  Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:  Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery  Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:   We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Integration Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the Product  Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI. We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI. Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow. The Team  At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design. We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record. About You  You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts. Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges. You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build. About the Role  Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into. A day’s work may include: Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems) Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture  Tech  Langs: Python / TS Infra: Nix, AWS Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)  What we’re looking for  Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours  What’s in it for you  This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly. We offer  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.  As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Gerente de FP&A e Controladoria Global
description:

O Grupo Nuveto está em busca de um(a) Gerente Global de FP&A e Controladoria  para liderar a governança financeira, a consolidação contábil e o planejamento financeiro das operações do grupo em múltiplos países. Essa posição terá como missão garantir a confiabilidade e a conformidade das informações financeiras, fortalecer os controles e processos corporativos, além de transformar dados financeiros e operacionais em análises estratégicas que apoiem a tomada de decisão da liderança, impulsionando o crescimento sustentável, a rentabilidade e a escalabilidade do negócio. Responsabilidades  Fechamento Contábil; Coordenar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das informações; Supervisionar a conciliação de contas e a consistência dos lançamentos contábeis entre as unidades do grupo; Gerenciar o processo de consolidação das demonstrações financeiras das entidades multipaíses, incluindo eliminações intercompany; Assegurar a correta apuração de resultados por unidade de negócio e por país, suportando a visão segmentada da liderança; Ser o ponto de contato principal com auditores externos, coordenando a entrega de informações e suporte às auditorias. Conformidade e Políticas Internas; Garantir a aderência das operações financeiras às políticas internas do grupo, normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS) e requisitos regulatórios de cada país; Desenvolver, documentar e revisar políticas e procedimentos de controladoria, promovendo padronização entre as unidades; Monitorar controles internos financeiros, identificando gaps e implementando melhorias para mitigar riscos operacionais; Suportar processos de due diligence e revisões internas, garantindo a integridade e rastreabilidade das informações financeiras; Assegurar que os processos de aprovação, alçadas e segregação de funções estejam implementados e operacionais. Relatórios Gerenciais e FP&A; Elaborar e evoluir continuamente o pacote de relatórios gerenciais mensais (management report) para o CFO, CEO e board; Construir análises de variância entre realizado e orçado (actual vs. budget / forecast), identificando desvios e propondo planos de ação em conjunto com as áreas de negócio; Apoiar o processo de orçamento anual (budget) e revisões de forecast, garantindo a consistência entre as premissas contábeis e financeiras; Desenvolver dashboards e indicadores financeiros relevantes para o modelo SaaS: MRR, ARR, Churn, CAC, LTV e Rule of 40; Traduzir dados contábeis em insights acionáveis para a liderança, conectando a visão financeira à estratégia do negócio.  Qualificações  Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas; Experiência sólida em controladoria com foco em fechamento contábil, relatórios gerenciais e conformidade; Vivência com operações em múltiplos países e consolidação de demonstrações financeiras intercompany; Domínio do ERP TOTVS (Protheus ou Datasul), especialmente nos módulos Contábil e Financeiro; Conhecimento de normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC/IFRS) e experiência com consolidação de demonstrações financeiras; Experiência na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e análises de variância (budget vs. actual); Inglês intermediário / avançado para comunicação com entidades internacionais  O que esperamos de você:  Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa, construindo relacionamentos de confiança e promovendo a integração entre diferentes áreas e países. Forte visão analítica para interpretar dados financeiros e operacionais, identificar tendências, antecipar riscos e apoiar decisões estratégicas. Perfil de liderança, com habilidade para influenciar stakeholders, conduzir projetos complexos; Proatividade para identificar oportunidades de melhoria, simplificar processos e fortalecer a governança financeira da organização; Comunicação clara e objetiva, sendo capaz de traduzir informações financeiras complexas em insights relevantes para diferentes públicos; Orientação para resultados, conciliando excelência técnica, visão de negócio e foco na geração de valor para a companhia;  Diferenciais que somam pontos:  Conhecimento de estruturação de dados e governança  Benefícios  Vale Refeição (Flash Benefícios); Recesso  Day Off no aniversário; Total Pass; Convênio Médico e Odontológico;  Modelo: Pessoa Jurídica Jornada: Segunda a sexta  Salário: A combinar  Nossa Cultura:  Crescemos com base em quatro pilares: Foco em Resultados, Compromisso com o Cliente, Inovação Contínua e Relacionamentos Transparentes. Aqui, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador, onde ideias ganham espaço e cada pessoa tem a oportunidade de fazer a diferença. Venha fazer parte desse time!

DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
